headline: CIN @ NYM matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CIN 3.99 at NYM 4.21, with a projected total of 8.21. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CIN: CIN moved -0.61 runs while NYM moved -1.10, changing the projected margin by +0.49 runs. The projected total fell -1.71, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +14.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Huascar Brazobán has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Juan Soto, Spencer Steer, Bo Bichette, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags MJ Melendez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
